title: Console support SPI, uniform exit codes and config section registration
summary: `Laravel\Console\CommandSupport` (Spi(Call) trait) and `Laravel\Console\InvalidCommandInput` give every AzGuard command one exit-code mapping (0 success, 2 input/panel/tenant/identity, 1 other) and panel selection; core grant helpers become `Laravel\Internal\Console\GrantCommandSupport`; every command — core, generators, install, stubs, audit prune — runs through `attempt()`; `Configuration\ConfigSections` lets an owner register its config root section (core registers `scaffold` on behalf of DevTools until P3).
why: Module commands depend on the internal console trait for exit codes and panel selection (R15); identities fix one exit-code contract for all commands (D16), which 0.7.0 applied only partly; core config validation must stop knowing module keys while still rejecting unknown roots (architecture#ownership). Hard risk: commands.json changes are intended and must match the identities rule exactly, nothing else.

include: Split `Laravel\Console\Concerns\InteractsWithAzGuard` → `Laravel\Console\CommandSupport` (members of knowledge/contracts#config) + `Laravel\Internal\Console\GrantCommandSupport` (remaining grant helpers); move `Laravel\Console\Concerns\InvalidCommandInput` → `Laravel\Console\InvalidCommandInput` (Spi(Call))

All AzGuard commands (knowledge/identities#commands, including explain, storage:migration, doctor, install, stubs, catalog:cache/clear, every make:*, audit:prune) run their body via `attempt()`; commands.json regenerated: only exit codes that now follow the 0/1/2 rule change

New `Configuration\ConfigSections` (Spi(Call)) with `own(string $root, Closure $validate)`; `AzGuardConfig` validates core roots itself and delegates registered roots; unknown root keys still rejected after registration; `scaffold` registered through it by the core provider (I2/I4 entry owner P3 if the scan flags it)
I4 entries of devtools/audit commands for InteractsWithAzGuard fixed; `StorageRegistry` use in MakeModelsCommand replaced by `AzGuard::storages()`
Migration lines: exit codes per command that changed; custom commands use CommandSupport

reads.why: Rules every P2 item follows (reference wins, no shims, D17 placement, attributes, snapshots, migration lines)
Report-mode allowlist protocol and which entries this item removes
Exact validation commands and driver environment
Owners/roots, Internal placement rule, stable FQCNs, composition roots — where new files go

rules: Every changed exit code in commands.json is listed in the item result with command and scenario.
ConfigSections::own() after the registry is frozen or twice for one root → InvalidConfigurationException.

composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check

ConfigSections with scaffold registered through it
